page.overview:
What is Hachinosu?

Hachinosu, also known as , is a New World island known to be a that is currently occupied by the Blackbeard Pirates. It is said to be where the Davy Back Fight originated and where the legendary Rocks Pirates were formed.

Following the downfall of the Rocks Pirates during the God Valley Incident, the island was ruled by Ochoku until the Rocky Port Incident, where he was ousted by Blackbeard. Blackbeard intends to turn Hachinosu into a World Government-allied nation, under the preliminary name of .

Hachinosu is a small-to-mid-sized island (still large enough to dwarf Thriller Bark) whose foundation consists of dark-gray rock. Centrally on it are constructions made of yellowish rock, most prominently a large, skull-fashioned formation in its center, towering over all else. A city of many smaller buildings (all square, crudely brick-built ones) surrounds said skull, as do a series of proportionally huge palm trees. When Shakuyaku lived on the island, Shakky's Rip-off Bar was located here.

The skull's inside is carved into what appears to be a fortress (where Blackbeard has been shown to reside), with the "nose" hole being a giant glass window (plus featuring additional, smaller windows dotting the skull here and there), and both "eye" holes go right through the whole structure. On the outside, the skull is carved to look like it is wearing a bandana, including a rocky protrusion on the left side shaped like the ends of a knot. Originally, this rock lacked its eyeholes and was simply described as "fish-like" until Rocks D. Xebec blasted the holes into existence.
